referenceOnlyStrengthening.idea: BOUNDED versus UNBOUNDED work classes with a derived compact execution frontier
referenceOnlyStrengthening.authority: reference-only; StudySyndicate owns its local implementation and task state

weakModelRules: Read the compact frontier before the full ledger.
If ROUTE is EXECUTE, do only the selected bounded task until its gate changes.
If ROUTE is DECOMPOSE, create bounded child tasks before implementation.
Do not infer completion from prose, a PR number, or green-looking text.
Do not analyze unrelated ledger items after a deterministic frontier is available.
proofCeiling: portable compatibility plus local task-granularity and deterministic frontier routing only
